verdict.rationale: Lambda's ODC instances preinstall 'Lambda Stack' (AI/ML drivers, tools, frameworks) and offer a 'GPU Base' minimal image, which covers PyTorch/CUDA-style ready environments, plus JupyterLab for quick start. However, there's no evidence of named pre-built templates for vLLM or ComfyUI specifically, only generic 'AI/ML tools and frameworks'. missing for 10: explicit vLLM template/image, explicit ComfyUI template/image, a documented template gallery/catalog beyond Lambda Stack and GPU Base.
